Naseer Ahmad Khan And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
on 17 November, 2023

Bench: Pritinker Diwaker, Ashutosh Srivastava
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:218541-Db
Chief Justice's Court
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 4547 of 2023
Petitioner :- Naseer Ahmad Khan And 3 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Rajesh Mani Tripathi,Devashish Tripathi

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Rakesh Kumar Maurya,Shweta Singh Hon'ble Pritinker Diwaker,Chief Justice Hon'ble Ashutosh Srivastava,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The petitioners, by means of this writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, are before this Court with a prayer to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 19.1.2023 registered as Case Crime No. 054 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 307, 341 IPC, Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and 3/4 Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage Act) P.S.
Tajganj, Distt. Agra.

entities.text: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage Act)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that this Court vide order dated 24.03.2023 had referred the matter to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court.

In compliance of the Naseer Ahmad Khan And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42757086/
1

entities.text: Naseer Ahmad Khan And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Court's order, settlement/agreement was arrived at between the parties on 10.10.2023.
A copy of the same is on record.
Perusal of the settlement/agreement, reveals that the parties have amicably settled their dispute and further agreed to withdraw all the cases pending between them.

The said fact has been mentioned in Paragraph Nos. 7 & 8 of the settlement/agreement dated 10.10.2023.
4.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and taking into account the settlement/agreement arrived at between the parties on 10.10.2023 before the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court, the proceedings in the aforesaid case are hereby quashed.
5.
The writ petition is accordingly allowed.
